title: Geoffrey N. Njang’ombe, Director (60)
columns:
Scholastica Odhiambo (Mrs.), Director (60)
Joined the boards of Co-optrust Investment Services Ltd in 2005 and Co-op Consultancy
& Insurance Agency Ltd in 2008. She has served at the Ministry of Finance and continues
to work with the Kenya Revenue Authority as a Revenue Officer, where she has served
for over 32 years. She holds a Bachelor of Business Administration and a Diploma in
Corporate Governance from the KCA University. She is a Director of Co-opholdings
Co-operative Society Limited.
